toolchain: DerpyNewbie ShaderLabParser 0.1.0 and glslang SPIR-V tools
reproduction_command: inspect_shader hello.shader; glslangValidator -D -V -S frag -e frag bound.frag.hlsl; spirv-val bound.spv
semantic_scope: The headless parser resolved the exact greeting as the display label of the typed _Color material property and verified its default RGBA values. The pass uses an HLSL fragment program whose emitted SPIR-V loads the matching property and writes it to the output.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
